# PV-DLAM P3 Qualification Summary

**Status:** STRUCTURALLY QUALIFIED EXTRACTED SHADOW-EVALUATION FRAMEWORK  
**Live routing:** unchanged / static  
**Learned routing:** not empirically qualified  
**Date:** 2026-10-07

P3 establishes the evidence machinery required before SuperPhiVessel may evaluate a learned router.

## Qualified ladder

| Rung | Evidence |
| --- | --- |
| **P3-A** | Immutable route outcomes anchored to exact P1-C receipts; all 108 GA108 identities represented; exact model/task/calibration history; SFR usefulness joins; dormant shadow rankings |
| **P3-B** | Deterministic group-held-out replay; paired-observed counterfactual discipline; unsupported alternatives abstain; no causal claim; SFR threshold flips abstain |
| **P3-C** | Explicit evidence floors; five-seed replay; task/route/SFR coverage gates; synthetic-fixture guard; deterministic P4 evaluation packet |

## Structural CI evidence

The P3-C qualification harness generates a labelled synthetic fixture containing:

- 420 paired replay cases;
- 4 task classes;
- 8 GA108 profiles;
- 2 exact model identities;
- 5 deterministic held-out seeds;
- 120 SFR-linked observations;
- 60 completed frontier investigations;
- 20 critical-issue cases with zero misses in the fixture.

The result is intentionally:

```text
STRUCTURAL_PASS_SYNTHETIC_ONLY
p4_evaluation_allowed = false
```

The fixture proves the gate machinery, not empirical router quality.

## Frozen P4 entry contract

The P4 evaluation packet requires later empirical evaluation with at least:

- 400 held-out tasks;
- 5 distinct seeds;
- 5% relative utility improvement;
- positive 95% confidence-interval lower bound;
- zero governance violations;
- no critical-miss regression;
- declared latency thresholds;
- operator-owned activation;
- rollback snapshot;
- automatic activation forbidden.

These are entry/evaluation constraints, not P3 performance claims.

## Invariants preserved

P3 leaves these unchanged:

```text
CAPABILITY ≠ AUTHORITY
MEMORY ≠ FACT
RETRIEVAL ≠ PROMPT ADMISSION
UNOBSERVED COUNTERFACTUAL ≠ OBSERVED OUTCOME
SHADOW EVIDENCE ≠ LIVE POLICY
```

P3 artifacts carry:

```text
may_change_live_route = false
may_change_live_thresholds = false
may_grant_authority = false
authority_granted = false
```

## What P3 does not establish

P3 completion does not establish:

- an empirically qualified learned router;
- live learned Genius/model selection;
- live learned Sparse Frontier thresholds;
- causal superiority of any route;
- production utility gains;
- learned NBG utility;
- automatic activation authority.

Those remain P4/P5 work.

## Next

P4 may now implement bounded learned-routing candidates, but they must stay shadow-only until a non-fixture P3 evidence corpus satisfies the P3-C gate and the P4 utility/confidence/governance/latency requirements are independently met.
